assertions.name: Exact six geometry records; deterministic star counts, maker spacing, date parsing and storage validation
Final public subpath HTTP 200; initial gold Lyra, full story, nonblank Canvas and nine self-hosted fonts
All six real stories select without scrolling; completed traces and matching SVG geometry
Native date and range synchronize, fixed bounds, reset preserves selected story
Keyboard 40px pan, bounded zoom, reset and pointer drag threshold/momentum stop
Create: actual pointer star selection, distinct 8-star limit, Undo/Clear and accessible selector
Local save survives date, resize and reload; load, six-save cap, inline-confirm delete
Guide: native modal focus trap, Escape dismissal and focus return
Malformed storage recovers; storage denial never claims a persistent save
Mobile 390×844: normal flow, touch selection, creation/save, scroll and no overflow before/after
Live reduced-motion preference: immediate trace/date/zoom with stable idle canvas
Independent static validation, public size under 20 MB, and zero browser/network errors
